rules.description: Calculate monthly interest for account balance based on interest rate
rules.condition: Processing transaction category balance with associated interest rate
rules.outcome: Monthly interest amount is computed and added to total interest

rules.description: Add monthly interest to total interest accumulator
rules.condition: After computing monthly interest for a transaction category
rules.outcome: Total interest is incremented by monthly interest amount

rules.description: Generate unique transaction ID by combining date and suffix
rules.condition: When writing a new interest transaction record
rules.outcome: Transaction ID is constructed from parameter date and incremented suffix

rules.description: Increment transaction ID suffix for each transaction
rules.condition: Before generating each new transaction record
rules.outcome: Transaction ID suffix is incremented by 1

rules.description: Assign transaction type code for interest transactions
rules.condition: When creating interest transaction record
rules.outcome: Transaction type code is set to '01' for interest transactions

rules.description: Assign transaction category code for interest transactions
rules.condition: When creating interest transaction record
rules.outcome: Transaction category code is set to '05' for interest

rules.description: Format DB2 timestamp from current date and time
rules.condition: When generating timestamp for transaction processing
rules.outcome: Current date is transformed into DB2-compatible timestamp format

rules.description: Calculate available credit by subtracting credit balance from credit limit
rules.condition: When authorization summary segment is found in IMS database
rules.outcome: Available credit amount is computed for authorization decision

rules.description: Decline authorization if transaction amount exceeds available credit
rules.condition: When transaction amount is greater than available credit from authorization summary
rules.outcome: Authorization is declined and insufficient fund flag is set

rules.description: Calculate available credit from account master when authorization summary not found
rules.condition: When authorization summary segment not found but account master exists
rules.outcome: Available credit is computed using account credit limit and current balance

rules.description: Decline authorization if transaction exceeds account credit limit
rules.condition: When transaction amount exceeds available credit from account master
rules.outcome: Authorization is declined and insufficient fund flag is set

rules.description: Set authorization response code to declined when authorization is denied
rules.condition: When authorization decision is to decline
rules.outcome: Response code is set to '05' and approved amount is set to zero

rules.description: Set authorization response code to approved when authorization is granted
rules.condition: When authorization decision is to approve
rules.outcome: Response code is set to '00' and approved amount equals requested amount

rules.description: Assign response reason code for invalid card
rules.condition: When authorization declined due to card not found or account/customer not found
rules.outcome: Response reason code is set to '3100' for invalid card

rules.description: Assign response reason code for insufficient funds
rules.condition: When authorization declined due to insufficient available credit
rules.outcome: Response reason code is set to '4100' for insufficient funds

rules.description: Assign response reason code for inactive card
rules.condition: When authorization declined because card is not active
rules.outcome: Response reason code is set to '4200' for card not active

rules.description: Assign response reason code for closed account
rules.condition: When authorization declined because account is closed
rules.outcome: Response reason code is set to '4300' for account closed

rules.description: Assign response reason code for card fraud
rules.condition: When authorization declined due to detected card fraud
rules.outcome: Response reason code is set to '5100' for card fraud

rules.description: Assign response reason code for merchant fraud
rules.condition: When authorization declined due to detected merchant fraud
rules.outcome: Response reason code is set to '5200' for merchant fraud

rules.description: Assign response reason code for unknown decline reasons
rules.condition: When authorization declined for reasons not matching specific categories
rules.outcome: Response reason code is set to '9000' for unknown reason

rules.description: Extract authorization date from 9's complement format
rules.condition: When processing authorization record from IMS database
rules.outcome: Authorization date is extracted by subtracting complement from 99999

rules.description: Calculate day difference between current date and authorization date
rules.condition: After extracting authorization date from complement format
rules.outcome: Number of days between current date and authorization date is computed

rules.description: Check if authorization has expired based on configurable expiry days
rules.condition: After calculating day difference between dates
rules.outcome: Authorization is marked for deletion if day difference exceeds or equals expiry threshold

rules.description: Increment purge counter for expired authorizations
rules.condition: When authorization meets expiry criteria
rules.outcome: Purge counter is incremented by 1

rules.description: Increment skip counter for non-expired authorizations
rules.condition: When authorization does not meet expiry criteria
rules.outcome: Skip counter is incremented by 1

rules.description: Validate transaction amount does not exceed available credit
rules.condition: When adding a transaction to account
rules.outcome: Transaction is rejected if amount exceeds difference between credit limit and current balance

rules.description: Validate account has not expired based on expiration date
rules.condition: When adding a transaction to account
rules.outcome: Transaction is rejected if current date exceeds account expiration date

rules.description: Update account current balance by adding transaction amount
rules.condition: When posting approved transaction to account
rules.outcome: Account current balance is increased by transaction amount

rules.description: Update account current cycle debit by adding transaction amount
rules.condition: When posting approved transaction to account
rules.outcome: Account current cycle debit is increased by transaction amount

rules.description: Validate user ID is not empty
rules.condition: When processing user signin request
rules.outcome: Error message is displayed if user ID is spaces or low-values

rules.description: Validate password is not empty
rules.condition: When processing user signin request
rules.outcome: Error message is displayed if password is spaces or low-values

rules.description: Validate password matches stored user password
rules.condition: When user record is found in security file
rules.outcome: Authentication fails if entered password does not match stored password

rules.description: Route admin users to admin menu
rules.condition: When user type is admin and authentication succeeds
rules.outcome: User is transferred to COADM01C admin program

rules.description: Route regular users to standard menu
rules.condition: When user type is not admin and authentication succeeds
rules.outcome: User is transferred to COMEN01C standard menu program

rules.description: Validate expiration month is within valid range
rules.condition: When updating card expiration date
rules.outcome: Month must be between 1 and 12, or error flag is set

rules.description: Validate expiration year is within valid range
rules.condition: When updating card expiration date
rules.outcome: Year must be between 1950 and 2099, or error flag is set

rules.description: Validate reissue date is not empty
rules.condition: When updating account reissue date
rules.outcome: Error flag is set if reissue date contains spaces

rules.description: Validate current balance is numeric
rules.condition: When updating account current balance
rules.outcome: Error flag is set if current balance is not numeric

rules.description: Validate credit limit is numeric
rules.condition: When updating account credit limit
rules.outcome: Error flag is set if credit limit is not numeric

rules.description: Validate cash credit limit is numeric
rules.condition: When updating account cash credit limit
rules.outcome: Error flag is set if cash credit limit is not numeric

rules.description: Validate first name is not empty
rules.condition: When adding new user
rules.outcome: Error flag is set if first name is spaces or low-values

rules.description: Validate last name is not empty
rules.condition: When adding new user
rules.outcome: Error flag is set if last name is spaces or low-values

rules.description: Validate user ID is not empty
rules.condition: When adding new user
rules.outcome: Error flag is set if user ID is spaces or low-values

rules.description: Validate password is not empty
rules.condition: When adding new user
rules.outcome: Error flag is set if password is spaces or low-values

rules.description: Validate user type is not empty
rules.condition: When adding new user
rules.outcome: Error flag is set if user type is spaces or low-values
